_format: DEV cases: tune on these. Each case is fed into its own fresh memory: the turns of each session (a string is a user message; {role, text, speaker} for assistant, tool, note or document), one minute apart from 'at', then a sleep. 'expect' checks the memory: 'current' must be a state true now, 'closed' a state that has ended with no current twin, 'absent' must not be a current state (catches misattribution); a state matches when its holder is in 'about' and every term occurs in its attribute and value; {"any": [...]} passes when one alternative does. 'events': terms in the gist, 'date' a prefix of the local day. 'finds': search for q must surface every term in one of its top 5 sentences or a current state. 'questions': asked with memory (and once without); every 'must' group needs one alternative in the answer, no 'must_not' group may match.
